SQL: SELECT m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt,COUNT(DISTINCT a.node_id) AS agreementCount FROM Meeting m LEFT JOIN rel_MADE_AT e ON e.dst_id=m.node_id LEFT JOIN Agreement a ON a.node_id=e.src_id WHERE m.workingGroup='RAN1' AND m.meetingNumberInt>=100 AND m.meetingNumberInt<=121 GROUP BY m.canonicalMeetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt ORDER BY meetingNumberInt ASC,meetingNumber ASC
requires: Complete ordered meeting/count/integer pool equals native and independent raw-incidence derivation; wrongcount/meeting/missing/duplicate/order/type plus synthetic alias/distinct/zero-domain controls. No result-based range/grouping switch.
